description_en: Creates hosts in a dedicated cluster
description_zh: 调用CreateDedicatedHost接口添加专属集群主机
kebab_example: aliyun cddc create-dedicated-host --dedicated-host-group-id dhg-6w7q18iwt5jo0000 --host-class rds.g6.4xlarge --pay-type prepaid --period Month --used-time 1 --client-token ETnLKlblzczshOTUbOCzSBZH80000 --auto-renew false --image-category AliLinux --os-password Test123456 --host-storage-type cloud_essd0 --host-storage 512 --biz-region-id cn-hangzhou --zone-id cn-hangzhou-i --vswitch-id vsw-bp133c8ifzxd3iv6q0000 --cluster-type onACK --cluster-alias test-on-ack-cluster --vpc-id vpc-xxxxxx --cluster-services Orchestrator3.2.6,Promethus2.49.1,Grafana10.2.3 --my-base-ecs-class '{"PeriodType":"Month","KeyPairName":"test0000","SystemDiskSize":40,"Amount":1,"AutoRenew":false,"Period":1,"DataDiskCount":2,"SecurityGroupIds":["sg-uf64zn0tc9qakm2j0000"],"SystemDiskCategory":"cloud_essd","InternetChargeType":"PayByTraffic","InternetMaxBandwidthOut":100,"ChargeType":"PrePaid","EcsClassCode":"ecs.g7.large","DataDiskSize":40,"DataDiskCategory":"cloud_essd","DepolymentSetId":"0000","Tags":["key1_:_value1"],"Password":"00000000000"}' --region cn-hangzhou
name: CreateDedicatedHost

parameters.help_en:
The dedicated cluster ID. You can log on to the ApsaraDB for MyBase console and go to the **Dedicated Clusters** page to view the dedicated cluster ID.

>  The database engine of the host is the same as the database engine of the cluster
parameters.help_zh:
目标集群ID。通过云数据库专属集群控制台**集群列表**查看目标集群ID。

> 主机的数据库类型与集群的数据库类型一致
parameters.name: dedicated_host_group_id

parameters.help_en: The instance type of the host. For information about the host instance types supported by different database engines, see https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/206343.html
parameters.help_zh: 主机的规格。关于不同数据库类型支持的主机规格，详情请参见https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/206343.html
parameters.name: host_class

parameters.help_en: The billing method of the host. Set the value to **prepaid**
parameters.help_zh: 主机的付费类型。取值为**prepaid**（包年包月）
parameters.name: pay_type

parameters.help_en:
The unit of the subscription duration. Valid values:

*   **Year**
*   **Month**
parameters.help_zh:
指定主机的预付费类型。取值：

<props="china">
* **Year**：包年。
* **Month**：包月。
* **Week**：包周。

</props>

<props="intl">
* **Year**：包年。
* **Month**：包月。

</props>
parameters.name: period

parameters.help_en:
The subscription duration of the host.

*   Valid values when **Period** is set to **Year**: **1** to **5**.****
*   Valid values when **Period** is set to **Month**: **1** to **9**
parameters.help_zh:
指定购买时长。取值：

<props="china">
* 当参数**Period**=**Year**时，**UsedTime**取值为**1**~**5**。
* 当参数**Period**=**Month**时，**UsedTime**取值为**1**~**9**。
* 当参数**Period**=**Week**时，**UsedTime**取值为**1**、**2**、**3**。

</props>

<props="intl">
* 当参数**Period**=**Year**时，**UsedTime**取值为**1**~**5**。
* 当参数**Period**=**Month**时，**UsedTime**取值为**1**~**9**。

</props>
parameters.name: used_time

parameters.help_en: The client token that is used to ensure the idempotence of the request. You can use the client to generate the token, but you must make sure that the token is unique among different requests. The token can contain only ASCII characters and cannot exceed 64 characters in length
parameters.help_zh: 客户端生成该参数值，用于保证请求的幂等性，防止重复提交请求。该参数值只能包含ASCII字符，且不超过64个ASCII字符
parameters.name: client_token

parameters.help_en:
Specifies whether to enable the auto-renewal feature. Valid values:

*   **true**
*   **false**

>  If you do not specify this parameter, the default value **false** is used
parameters.help_zh:
是否开启自动续费功能。取值：
* **true**：开启。
* **false**：不开启。

> 不填写默认为**false**
parameters.name: auto_renew

parameters.help_en:
The image of the host. Valid values:

*   **WindowsWithMssqlEntAlwaysonLicense**: SQL Server Cluster Edition.
*   **WindowsWithMssqlStdLicense**: SQL Server Standard Edition.
*   **WindowsWithMssqlEntLicense**: SQL Server Enterprise Edition.
*   **WindowsWithMssqlWebLicense**: SQL Server Web Edition.
*   **AliLinux**: other images.

>  When you create a host that runs SQL Server, you must specify a host image
parameters.help_zh:
主机镜像。取值：
  - **WindowsWithMssqlEntAlwaysonLicense**：SQL Server集群版
  - **WindowsWithMssqlStdLicense**：SQL Server标准版
  - **WindowsWithMssqlEntLicense**：SQL Server企业版
  - **WindowsWithMssqlWebLicense**：SQL Server Web版
  - **AliLinux**：其他主机镜像

> 创建SQL Server主机时，需要填写对应版本的主机镜像
parameters.name: image_category

parameters.help_en:
The password of the host. You can specify a password only when you create a host in a **Proprietary MyBase** dedicated cluster.

*   The password must be 8 to 30 characters in length.
*   The password must contain at least three of the following character types: uppercase letters, lowercase letters, digits, and special characters.
*   The password can contain the following special characters: () \ \` ~ ! @ # $ % ^ & \* - \_ + = | { } \[ ] : ; ' < > , . ? /
parameters.help_zh:
主机密码。 仅集群类型为**私有部署集群**时，支持创建主机密码。密码需符合如下要求：
- 长度为8~30个字符。
- 必须至少包含三项：大写字母、小写字母、数字和特殊字符。
- 特殊符号：()\\`~!@#$%^&*-_+=|{}\[\]:;'<>,.?/
parameters.name: os_password

parameters.help_en:
The disk type of the host. This parameter takes effect only for dedicated clusters that run Tair. Valid values:

*   **cloud_essd**: PL1 enhanced SSD (ESSD).
*   **cloud_essd0**: PL0 ESSD
parameters.help_zh:
主机磁盘类型，仅针对Tair类型主机生效，当前只支持以下两种类型：
- **cloud_essd**：PL1云盘
- **cloud_essd0**：PL0云盘
parameters.name: host_storage_type

parameters.help_en:
The disk storage of the host. This parameter takes effect only for dedicated clusters that run Tair. Unit: GB. Valid values:

*   512
*   1024
*   1536
*   2048
*   2560
*   3072
*   3584
*   4096
parameters.name: host_storage

parameters.help_en: The zone ID. You can call the https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/214103.html operation to query the most recent zone list
parameters.help_zh: 可用区ID。调用https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/214103.html接口查询可用区ID
parameters.name: zone_id

parameters.help_en: The vSwitch ID. You can view the vSwitch ID in the Virtual Private Cloud (VPC) console
parameters.help_zh: 虚拟交换机的ID，可通过专有网络控制台查看目标虚拟机ID
parameters.name: vswitch_id

parameters.help_en: The deployment type of the Self-managed MyBase cluster. Valid values: onACK and onECS
parameters.help_zh: MyBase 开放版使用，创建开放版集群类型：onACK、onECS
parameters.name: cluster_type

parameters.help_en: The alias of the Self-managed MyBase cluster
parameters.help_zh: MyBase开放版使用，开放版集群别名
parameters.name: cluster_alias

parameters.help_en: The VPC ID of the Self-managed MyBase cluster
parameters.name: vpc_id

parameters.help_en: The services associated with the instances in the Self-managed MyBase on Elastic Compute Service (ECS) cluster
parameters.help_zh: MyBase开放版onECS实例关联的服务
parameters.name: cluster_services

fields.help_en:
The billing method. Valid values:

*   PrePaid: subscription.
*   PostPaid: pay-as-you-go
fields.help_zh:
付费类型，取值如下：
- PrePaid：预付费。
- PostPaid：后付费
fields.name: charge_type

fields.help_en: The number of hosts that you want to create
fields.name: amount

fields.help_en: The subscription duration of the host. The Period parameter must be specified when ChargeType is set to PrePaid
fields.help_zh: 购买on ECS主机的包年包月时长。当参数ChargeType取值为PrePaid时，Period参数必填
fields.name: period

fields.help_en: The unit of the subscription duration. Default value: Month
fields.help_zh: 包年包月时长的单位，默认为Month（月）
fields.name: period_type

fields.help_en: The size of the system disk. Unit: GB
fields.name: system_disk_size

fields.help_en: The type of the system disk
fields.name: system_disk_category

fields.help_en: The size of the data disk. Unit: GB
fields.name: data_disk_size

fields.help_en: The type of the data disk
fields.name: data_disk_category

fields.help_en: Specifies whether to enable auto-renewal for the host. Default value: false
fields.name: auto_renew

fields.help_en: The name of the key pair
fields.name: key_pair_name

fields.help_en: The IDs of the security groups to which the instance belongs
fields.name: security_group_ids

fields.help_en: The tags that you want to add to the host
fields.name: tags

fields.help_en:
The maximum outbound public bandwidth. Unit: Mbit/s.

Default value: 0. If you specify the parameter to a value greater than 0, a public IP address is automatically created
fields.help_zh:
公网出带宽最大值，单位为Mbit/s。

默认值：0。设定为大于0时会自动创建公网IP
fields.name: internet_max_bandwidth_out

fields.help_en:
The metering method for network usage. Valid values:

*   PayByBandwidth
*   PayByTraffic
fields.help_zh:
网络计费类型。取值范围：
- PayByBandwidth：按固定带宽计费。
- PayByTraffic：按使用流量计费
fields.name: internet_charge_type
